certificate: Same anchors, limits and full module/path catalog; consult all relevant source files including unsuccessful lookups. Candidate permits incomplete graphs only with their unknown/truncated states unchanged. Persistent indexing must update changed files and invalidate affected module-resolution state. No externally supplied certificates.
claim_boundary: Canonical equality with this bounded static resolver, not Python semantic soundness, coding-agent effectiveness, independent human evaluation, or a new incremental-computation principle.
correctness_gate: Zero canonical graph mismatches against warm_ast_rebuild for every anchor, version, method, warmup and measured trajectory. Preserve incomplete, ambiguous, missing and truncated statuses. Any mismatch blocks delivery of the reuse implementation regardless of speed.
fairness: All methods share an indexed corpus within each snapshot across anchors and use warm AST caches within one trajectory. Both incremental methods maintain the same persistent index policy; the incremental baseline rebuilds all graphs. Each method/repetition starts with a new GraphSession. No measured state survives between trajectories. Whole-corpus guard and read-set-any-status are retained comparators.
hypothesis: Combining persistent file/module indexing with consulted-file read-set reuse reduces full replay cost beyond persistent incremental indexing with every graph rebuilt.

memory.limitations: RSS includes interpreter/import/source/graph/index overhead and native allocations. Traced Python memory is partial and instrumentation affects allocation behavior, so Python heap measurements use separate subprocesses and never feed the RSS gate. OS high-water RSS is not an index-only measurement.
metrics: Uninstrumented RUSAGE_SELF ru_maxrss high-water peak normalized to bytes on macOS/Linux
Separate tracemalloc subprocess peak Python bytes
Separate tracemalloc subprocess post-gc retained Python bytes after each version
memory.primary_gate: For every repository, candidate median full-trajectory peak RSS must be at most twice incremental_index_rebuild median peak RSS and at most 536870912 bytes (512 MiB). Report all raw runs, medians, maximums and ratios, including gate failures.
memory.process_policy: Two separate modalities, rss (without tracemalloc) and python_traced (with tracemalloc); three fresh subprocesses per modality/method/repository, each one complete eight-revision trajectory; no in-process warmup. Compare medians across three processes. RSS gate uses only the uninstrumented rss modality. Instrumented runs are not timing runs.

natural.anchor_rule: Parse only oldest-revision production .py/.pyi source with stdlib ast. Enumerate top-level FunctionDef/AsyncFunctionDef; retain first declaration metadata for duplicate path:symbol identities while preserving all declarations in source. Sort identities by SHA256(path + colon + symbol), take first 24. Anchor metadata is fixed across all revisions. Retain all ambiguous, unchanged, missing, unresolved and truncated graph outcomes without reselection.
natural.revision_rule: Latest stable non-draft GitHub release returned at pin time, and its seven immediate first parents. Pin exact eight SHA values before inspecting source outcomes. Retain every intervening transition even if source-identical; do not extend or replace histories after examining graph or timing outcomes. If the release/first-parent chain is unavailable, record failure and seek a documented premeasurement amendment rather than silently substitute.
natural.selection_reason: Four separately maintained permissive Python packages from different domains, absent from every repository in third_party/manifest.json and the four selective-reuse development repositories. They are distinct projects, not versions/forks/source-copy variants. Convenience selection is not population sampling.
natural.source_rule: Retain UTF-8 .py and .pyi files under fixed package prefixes; exclude path components test/tests/fixtures/vendor/vendored/_vendor/generated and filenames beginning test_. Do not execute third-party code. Record every excluded source count and all parse failures during anchor enumeration. Preserve undecodable files as exclusions, not replacement candidates.
natural.unit: Repository. Trajectories, revisions and anchors are repeated/dependent observations.
natural.viability_rule: Metadata/license/source-resource viability only: nonarchived nonfork repository with recent upstream activity (within 24 months of protocol date), permissive license, eight linked revisions, exactly 24 eligible anchors and at least one changed production-source file across the interval. Record any failure without inspecting graphs or timings and require an explicit premeasurement amendment for substitution.

novelty_boundary: Engineering application/evaluation of established incremental-computation and dependency-tracking ideas. Research novelty requires a separate literature argument and external end-to-end task evidence.

primary_comparison.statistic: For each repository and method, sum elapsed_ns over all seven replay transitions in each complete measured trajectory; compare medians of the five trajectory totals. Initial capture is reported separately and capture-plus-replay totals are a required secondary metric. Do not pool anchors or transitions as independent samples.
primary_comparison.target: At least 20 percent lower median end-to-end replay trajectory time on at least three of the four fixed repositories, with zero canonical mismatches; disclose every repository regression and the memory gate outcome.

reporting: Retain all source-identical transitions, all outcomes and failures; report corpus sizes, changed-path counts, source-unchanged fraction, anchor coverage, per-repository timing ranges and both trajectory totals. No significance or representative-natural-prevalence claim from four convenience-sampled repositories. Keep historical exploratory development outcomes separate. Do not tune implementation after held-out timings without marking the study developmental and acquiring a new untouched holdout.
status: Prespecified repository-held-out convenience sample; frozen before candidate graph extraction or timings; not public preregistration.

timing.initial_capture: Record separately for each trajectory and include in required secondary capture-plus-replay totals. No primary replay-only result may be described as overall cold-start speedup.
timing.order: Rotate whole method trajectories by repository index and repetition, preserving revision order within each trajectory; save the actual order.
